build_azure_ad_token_provider: build an Azure AD token provider callable using service principal credentials and a custom scope
infer_credential_type_from_environment: infer the Azure credential type from environment variables like client ID, secret, tenant ID, and certificate path
create_azure_client_secret_credential: create an Azure client secret credential using client ID, client secret, and tenant ID from environment variables
create_azure_certificate_credential: create an Azure certificate credential using client ID, tenant ID, certificate path, and optional password
run_default_azure_credential: run DefaultAzureCredential to automatically discover and use the best available Azure authentication method
